answer: Detection first: each epoch a comet — a random audit — strikes a random slice of identities and demands fresh work derived from its seed, which no one can precompute. Every identity keeps a lagoon, a public rolling log of genuine recent actions; the oasis of payouts opens only to lagoons that stay current. An honest agent answers one small comet task per epoch, nearly free. A farmer's 1,000 fakes must each keep a live lagoon and answer every comet strike with real work, and one stale lagoon or failed response drains that fake's share back to the oasis.
